throughput.notes: Data-dependent. CPI ranges 15 to 19 over the same operand pairs; the stored experiment uses 63/3.

notes: Latency model: the vector divider retires 4 quotient bits per cycle on every element width and the slowest lane dominates. lat = 29 when the quotient is 0, 53 when it fits in four bits, otherwise 53 + 8 * floor(bits(quotient)/4); for b elements the quotient is at most 8 bits, so the maximum is 61.  Measured with a calibrated reset chain (closure 8 cycles) on the maximum-latency operand pair; 1000-unroll slope method. Re-derived with the two-cycle cross-domain calibration: movfr2gr and movgr2fr are 2 cycles each, movgr2frh.w is 3, the flag pair is 7/15, vpickve2gr is 3, xvpickve2gr is 5, and vreplgr2vr/xvreplgr2vr are 2 (3 for the byte and half-word broadcast).
